_doc: GitHub-RELEASES nix binary cache — the incremental deploy transport (2026-07-11, was gh-pages until git rejected the large nar push with HTTP 500 / send-pack disconnect on all 3 runs). CI (ship_nix-flakes_desktop_hm.yaml) builds the HM closure, `nix copy --to` writes the CUSTOM store paths (closure minus what cache.nixos.org already serves = tens of MB) into a signed local nix cache dir, tars it (asset_name) and uploads it as an ASSET on a rolling Release tag (release_tag) with --clobber. Release assets hold large binaries fine — unlike a git branch. The desktop's `build.sh switch` does `gh release download` (one small asset) → extract → `nix copy --from file://<dir>` the custom paths → `nix copy --from cache.nixos.org` the toplevel (custom already local) → activate. Streaming, NO 6GB full artifact, NO 14G staging, works on the disk-full 8GB box, no freeze. `nix copy --from file://` works for the non-root user with no trusted-user/system change. Public key here (not secret); private signing key in vault + the NIX_CACHE_PRIVKEY GH Actions secret.
